The television series titled "José Rizal" premiered on October 20, 2014, on GMA Network's Telebabad line up, replacing "My Destiny." It concluded on November 14, 2014, with a total of 20 episodes, and was replaced by "More Than Words" in its timeslot. In March 2016, the series was released on DVD by GMA Records Home Video. The series is currently streaming on YouTube.

The series revolves around José Rizal, portrayed by Alden Richards, who had to leave his family to pursue his studies and career abroad, while also dealing with homesickness and a long-distance relationship with the woman he loved. Upon his return home, he utilizes the knowledge and skills he acquired abroad to better the lives of his family and fellow countrymen.

The supporting cast includes Kylie Padilla as Leonor Rivera, Eula Valdez as Teodora "Lolay" Alonso y Mercado, Solenn Heussaff as Nellie Boustead, Jaclyn Jose as Conchita Monteverde, Ricardo Cepeda as Francisco Mercado, Marco Castleberry, Kenna, and others.

In a related article, "A Murder Mystery Puzzle" published in Scientific American (vol. 329, no. 4, November 2023, pp. 81–82), it is mentioned that natural-language processing (NLP) models, despite their impressive capabilities, are limited by the context they receive. This limitation could pose challenges for researchers aiming to use them to analyze ancient languages, as there may be insufficient historical records from long-gone civilizations to serve as training data.

In another article, "Your Lying Eyes," published in The New Yorker (20 November 2023, pp. 54–59), it is discussed that the emergence of AI-generated fake videos indistinguishable from real ones could have significant implications. The article delves into the potential consequences of such deepfakes.
